name: Harvard Undergraduate Data Project
shortDescription: Student group that obtains public Harvard data and analyzes it, publishing findings on campus topics like elections and concentration trends.

sources.title: Harvard Undergraduate Data Project

activityReasons: listed on a current official directory
longDescription: Our flagship product is Harvard’s first open data catalog, where we’ve gathered dozens of public Harvard datasets in a free repository. We’ve used data science and data visualization techniques to analyze data on campus safety, faculty gender disparity, student government election turnout, and trends in concentration popularity, to name a few.
